name: Cormac Baird
source_profile:
Important Figures Cormac Baird (LN) — Town Sheriff

Cormac is a former forester and longtime resident of Thornhollow who served as an informal peacekeeper during the settlement's earlier years. Familiar with the surrounding woodland
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 111 (source excerpt; may be partial)
